title: The cutover extract layout, the place of the two ACE business keys on the interaction row and the owning data product of contact_point_ext are not fixed by any target source
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Data Migration Stories v3.md RWB-DM-005 (AC1, AC3, Data table); FSD P1 v3 A2.2 (DP02 and DP05 rows), A2.11 and A2.12; TSD P1 v3 T3.3 views 3 and 4, T3.5, T3.6 interaction and reconciliation_result, T3.10; legacy RWB-DM-005 validation table
section: s3 Preconditions; s11 Data; s12.7 Tables owned; s12.8 Contract fakes; s13 Configuration; s15 Screens and states
description: Three values this story must write are not settled by the sources it may use. First, the cutover is started by the release pipeline as one-off bulk work (Architecture v5 slide 32) but no source gives the layout, file name or record format of the legacy cutover dump, the pipeline step name, the shape of the cutover record that holds the ten day rows and the sign-off, or the feature-flag name, so the extract reader, the evidence reader and the monitor states are built against a default. Second, the legacy data row names person_key and contact_key on the interaction while the ledger table defines party_id and contact_point_id as cross-references and carries no column of either name, so where the two ACE business keys sit on a migrated row is not stated; the ask cannot be met by inventing a party or contact identifier the legacy Workbench never held. Third, the FSD files contact_point_ext under DP02 Customer and party and gives DP05 Contact and promises only interaction, while the legacy data row of this key carries the consent and contact-quality rows with it, so which slice loads those rows is not stated either. Each point changes an artefact of this story and none of them blocks the build: the apply-side defaults are recorded as assumptions ASM-B2-P1-004-1, -2, -3 and -5.
evidence: Legacy RWB-DM-005: Endpoints 'No endpoint in this story. The migration is a cutover step run by the recovery service identity, and its breaks are listed on the reconciliation extract'; Data table rows for interaction and contact_point_ext; AC3 'Given ten clean days on the migrated records'. FSD P1 v3 A2.2: DP02 reads v_ace_customer, v_ace_contact, v_ace_ca_relation and v_ace_party_product with Workbench tables party_ext and contact_point_ext; DP05 reads v_ace_efs_action, v_ace_efs_action_code and v_ace_efs_assignment with Workbench table interaction. TSD P1 v3 T3.6: interaction is not re-specified, and the reconciliation_result rows are written by JOB-04 only. TSD P1 v3 T3.5: contact_point_ext is a 1:1 extension table keyed by contact_key with no ACE copy.
owner_role: Data steward and data product owner
proposed: Settle the three points at the cutover rehearsal: publish the dump layout and cutover record format with the release pipeline owner, add the two business-key columns to the interaction dictionary rows or state that source_ref carries them, and record in the data product catalog whether contact_point_ext is loaded by the DP05 cutover or by the DP02 story.
